title: Interest, Growth and Depreciation
summary: Simple and compound interest, population growth, and things that lose value over time.

ib.note: Compound growth is MYP 3 (exponential models in MYP 4–5)

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 1: Fractions in Disguise

objectives: I can calculate compound interest, including half-yearly compounding.
I can apply growth and depreciation formulas to real situations.
misconceptions: Compound interest is the same as simple interest.
Depreciating 10% a year for 10 years means the item is worthless.
Compounding more often makes no difference.
